title: Tom Clancy's The Division: Compromised
summary: Thomas Parrott's licensed Operation: Crossroads novel follows a Division cell drawn into a Gulf Coast supply crisis after the events of its preceding novel.

claims.text: Compromised is Thomas Parrott's second Operation: Crossroads novel in the licensed Tom Clancy's The Division publishing line.
The novel's published premise places Division Agent Maira Kanhai in a Texas refinery crisis involving environmental extremists and a private military force.

paragraphs.text: Compromised is a licensed Division transmedia novel, not a game mission or a replacement for game-source chronology. It is the second Operation: Crossroads book by Thomas Parrott.

Its source-specific story follows Maira Kanhai into a Texas Gulf Coast dispute over refinery infrastructure, bringing novel-origin factions and rogue activity into the archive with major-spoiler handling.
